Products.DescriptionEn: The Diamond 9000 uses 62,000 sonic vibrations per minute to remove up to 10x more plaque than a manual brush. Five cleaning modes, a smart pressure sensor and a two-minute quadrant timer make it the dentist favourite.
Products.DescriptionAr: تستخدم دايموند 9000 62,000 اهتزازة صوتية في الدقيقة لإزالة بلاك أكثر بـ10 مرات من الفرشاة اليدوية. خمسة أوضاع تنظيف ومستشعر ضغط ذكي ومؤقت رباعي يجعلها المفضلة لدى أطباء الأسنان.

Products.DescriptionEn: A clinically tested LED whitening system that brightens teeth up to 8 shades in 14 days. Includes an LED mouth tray, 3 premium whitening gel syringes and a sensitive-teeth formula.

Features: Up to 8 shades brighter in 14 days

Products.TaglineAr: معجون تبييض يومي بجودة عيادات الأسنان

Products.DescriptionEn: A complete set of colour-coded interdental brushes sized 0.4–1.6mm to clean between teeth and around implants and braces. Includes a hygienic travel case.

Products.DescriptionEn: Four premium soft-bristle brush heads compatible with all major sonic brush handles. Each head lasts up to 3 months for a full year of clean.

Products.DescriptionEn: A gentle, fluoride-free toothpaste with a bubblegum flavour kids love. Safe to swallow, it makes brushing a fun daily habit for ages 2+.

Products.DescriptionEn: A zero-alcohol rinse enriched with xylitol and chamomile. Soothing for sensitive mouths, it freshens breath and balances the oral microbiome.

Products.DescriptionEn: A compact travel set with a foldable brush, mini toothpaste, floss and mouthwash in a leak-proof case. Perfect for work, gym and trips.
Products.DescriptionAr: مجموعة سفر مدمجة مع فرشاة قابلة للطي ومعجون مصغّر وخيط وغسول في علبة مانعة للتسرب. مثالية للعمل والجيم والرحلات.

Products.DescriptionEn: Activated coconut charcoal toothpaste that gently polishes stains away without harsh abrasives. Enriched with coconut oil and mint for a fresh, natural clean.
Products.DescriptionAr: معجون بفحم جوز الهند النشط يزيل البقع بلطف دون مواد كاشطة قاسية. مدعّم بزيت جوز الهند والنعناع لتنظيف طبيعي منعش.

Products.DescriptionEn: A complete oral care kit for braces: ortho wax, interdental brushes, floss threaders and a mirror. Keeps brackets clean and gums healthy through treatment.
Products.DescriptionAr: مجموعة عناية فموية كاملة للتقويم: شمع تقويم وفرش بينية وخيوط تنظيف ومرآة. تحافظ على نظافة الحاصرات وصحة اللثة طوال فترة العلاج.

Reviews.Content: We recommend the Diamond 9000 to every patient. Quiet, powerful, and the pressure sensor genuinely protects gum health.
Upgraded from a manual brush two months ago — my dentist noticed the difference at the last check-up. Battery lasts weeks.
Great brush overall. The travel case is a nice touch for conferences. Only wish the app showed more brushing history.
Patients see visible results in the first week. The LED tray is comfortable and the sensitive formula is a thoughtful addition.
Four shades brighter in two weeks, exactly as promised. No sensitivity at all thanks to the extra gel. Highly recommend.
Solid kit — trays feel premium and instructions are clear. Took a little longer than 14 days for full results but I am happy.
Excellent product — our clinic has been ordering this for months and it never disappoints. Consistent quality and fast delivery.
Really good value for the price. Works exactly as described, packaging was secure. Would have liked a slightly larger size.
Our hygienists love it. Reliable supply, always in stock, and the volume pricing makes a real difference for the practice.
Fast shipping and exactly as pictured. Delivery arrived in two days. Happy with the purchase overall.
Decent product, but the box arrived slightly damaged. DentZone support resolved it quickly with a replacement though.
Exactly what our dental lab needed. Great quality, great support, and the free shipping threshold is easy to reach.
